title: Sum of Nodes with Exactly One Child
statement: Given the root of a binary tree, return the sum of values of all nodes that have exactly one child (i.e., either left or right child is present, but not both). If the tree is empty, return 0.
summary: Compute the sum of node values that have exactly one child in a binary tree.
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [0, 10^4].

examples.explanation:
The tree is:
        1
       / \
      2   3
     /     \
    4       5
Nodes 2 and 3 each have exactly one child, so sum = 2 + 3 = 5.
Every internal node has two children, leaves have none.
